models.name: ReaderClientSync

properties.name: TypeOK
properties.summary: All server, client store, outbox, conflict, and reading-position variables remain within well-formed types and bounds.
properties.harm: Malformed state or out-of-range sequence/version counters corrupt sync persistence or crash clients.

properties.name: OutboxUniquePerKey
properties.summary: Each client's durable outbox holds at most one pending entry per (bookId, kind, recordId) key after coalescing.
properties.harm: Duplicate outbox items for the same record cause redundant pushes, stale baseVersion conflicts, and unbounded offline queue growth.

properties.name: DirtyRecordNeverOverwrittenByPull
properties.summary: Pulling remote pages never overwrites a local record that still has an unpushed edit in the durable outbox.
properties.harm: Silent loss of user highlights or notes edited offline when a background pull lands before push completes.

properties.name: CursorMonotonicWithinServer
properties.summary: Within a given serverId, each client's pull cursor never moves backward and never exceeds the server's sequence number.
properties.harm: Cursor regression causes redundant re-application loops or skipped envelopes; advancing past serverSeq drops remote edits.

properties.name: ResolvedVersionMatchesServerHead
properties.summary: Immediately after Mac resolves a conflict, Mac's local serverVersion equals the server's new head version (headVersion + 1).
properties.harm: Storing a stale version (such as conflict.baseVersion + 1) causes the next Mac edit to push a stale baseVersion and trigger a spurious second conflict.

properties.name: MidSessionPositionNeverJumps
properties.summary: Pulling a remote reading position while a book is open stores it for the next open without moving the reader's active page.
properties.harm: Reader's viewport jumps away mid-reading when another device finishes syncing its last page.

properties.name: DiskFullNeverBlocksRecordSync
properties.summary: HTTP 507 disk_full / quota_exceeded pauses book blob uploads without halting annotation record push/pull.
properties.harm: A full sync server disk silently blocks all highlight, note, and vocabulary syncing.

properties.name: EventualConvergence
properties.summary: Temporal liveness: once finite edits, position scrolls, dropped responses, and server rebuilds stop, Mac and Phone converge to the server head, versions, and cursor even if book uploads remain paused for disk_full.
properties.harm: Mac and Phone stay permanently diverged with different annotation bodies or stale versions while displaying a green 'Synced' chip.

non_goals: TailDrive server internal SQLite implementation and authentication/QR token cryptography.
Multi-megabyte resumable blob Range/Content-Range byte-offset chunking.
JSON serialization schema validation or SwiftUI/React Native UI rendering of conflict sheets.

models.name: VaultOwnedBlocks

properties.name: TypeOK
properties.summary: All disk file, user-slice, block-body, session, watcher, and delete-provenance variables stay well-typed.
properties.harm: Corrupted coordinator state produces malformed Markdown markers or lost block tracking.

properties.name: UserTextByteInvariant
properties.summary: Every user-authored Markdown slice outside Reader's HTML comment markers remains byte-for-byte identical across all Reader upserts, removes, flushes, and merges.
properties.harm: Reader mutates or erases a user's handwritten Obsidian notes outside Reader-owned blocks.

properties.name: NoSilentClobberOnConcurrentEdit
properties.summary: An external Obsidian edit to a Reader-owned block is never silently overwritten by a concurrent Reader flush; conflicting edits preserve both bodies via 3-way merge.
properties.harm: User edits made in Obsidian during Reader's watcher/flush window vanish silently without a conflict callout.

properties.name: MissingFileNeverPushesDeletes
properties.summary: Q-M1 delete guard: external deletion or renaming of a chapter Markdown file never synthesizes delete tombstones into sync.
properties.harm: Renaming or temporarily moving a notes file in Obsidian wipes synced highlights and notes across all paired devices.

properties.name: OwnWriteEchoIgnored
properties.summary: Filesystem watcher events caused by Reader's own write matching lastWritten are recognized via VaultSync.isOwnWrite and ignored as echoes.
properties.harm: Self-write echo loops cause repeated re-parses, flicker, or spurious conflict callouts.

non_goals: Malicious or syntactically broken HTML comments nested inside code fences (covered by property tests in ReaderCoreTests).
POSIX kqueue / DispatchSourceFileSystemObject kernel event coalescing timing.
Vocabulary Markdown file table layout or concepts/mastery JSON parsing.

models.name: AppUpdaterStateMachine

properties.name: TypeOK
properties.summary: All updater phases, bundle slots (TARGET, BACKUP, STAGED), candidate attributes, and audit flags remain well-typed.
properties.harm: Invalid updater state transitions leak stale bundles or spawn duplicate swap scripts.

properties.name: NoUnverifiedInstall
properties.summary: No candidate release can reach ready_to_install, swap execution, or TARGET without passing Ed25519 signature verification, schema/channel/URL-prefix policy checks, SHA-256 checksum verification, and bundle/codesign validation.
properties.harm: Tampered, MITM'd, or corrupted app archive replaces Reader.app on the user's Mac.

properties.name: NoSilentDowngrade
properties.summary: Production builds never accept a lower buildNumber or identical (buildNumber, commitSHA); dev builds never upgrade silently during background checks.
properties.harm: Replay of an older signed manifest silently downgrades Reader to a vulnerable or broken release, or overwrites a developer's local dev build.

properties.name: RollbackPreservesRunnableApp
properties.summary: At every swap step a runnable app exists in TARGET or BACKUP; if mv/ditto or launch fails, restore_backup restores TARGET to the prior valid bundle and cleans BACKUP.
properties.harm: Failed cross-volume swap or broken launch leaves the user with a missing or half-copied Reader.app.

properties.name: StagedSwapTerminatesCleanly
properties.summary: Temporal liveness: once a staged swap script spawns, it always terminates cleanly in either done_installed or done_rolled_back.
properties.harm: Swap script hangs or stalls midway with Reader.app stranded in .Reader.app.backup.

non_goals: Cryptographic hardness of Curve25519 / Ed25519 or SHA-256 primitives (assumed sound in Apple CryptoKit).
macOS Gatekeeper / notarization ticket stapling and LaunchServices caching.
External deletion of TARGET or BACKUP by another process while swap-and-relaunch.sh is running.
